abstract: The main findings of the comparison are as follows. Overall, Cardivel reduces side effects compared with Standard care. Overall, Cardivel improves systolic drop compared with Standard care.
conclusion: In the end, the evidence on each measure reads like this. Overall, Cardivel reduces side effects compared with Standard care. Overall, Cardivel improves systolic drop compared with Standard care.
section:
### A further comparison between arms

Standard care is the usual blood pressure treatment given to every patient. Cardivel is a tablet that slows the heart so it pushes with less force. All data for this comparison were collected at the Riverside Pressure Registry.

Table 4. The measure for each arm, shown subset by subset.

| Subset | Arm | Measure | Count | Total |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Younger adults, Normal kidney function, University hospital | Standard care | Side effects | 124 | 450 |
| Younger adults, Normal kidney function, University hospital | Cardivel | Side effects | 92 | 450 |
| Younger adults, Reduced kidney function, University hospital | Standard care | Side effects | 111 | 450 |
| Younger adults, Reduced kidney function, University hospital | Cardivel | Side effects | 99 | 450 |
